title: VRMC_character_expression_lookat.expressions
description: The mapping of look-at expressions to the expressions defined in KHR_character_expression. Each mapped value MUST match an expression name defined in KHR_character_expression.expressions. The values of lookUp, lookDown, lookLeft, and lookRight MUST be distinct from each other.

lookUp.description: The name of the expression used for looking up.

lookDown.description: The name of the expression used for looking down.

lookLeft.description: The name of the expression used for looking left.

lookRight.description: The name of the expression used for looking right.
